text: In the village of Tualang Tiga in 1901, the hunchback Si Bongkok paints beautifully but is [shunned for his ugly face|who_suffers|outcasts and the marginalised]. Carried into the hidden realm of the bunian, he is made handsome on one condition, that he [swear never to kill another person|rules|break the rule and pay]. When he breaks the oath his beauty turns invisible to everyone, and the devil offers [a false bargain|origin|bargains with dark powers]: as the oily man, he must rape twenty-one girls in seven days and worship Satan as his god, while [the whole village lives in terror of him|who_suffers|whole communities].
